Desktop launcher

CI-Applet

A Tauri-based launcher and tray shell for the existing Rust capture engine. Use the tray icon to launch monitoring, open settings, or bring this window back into view.

What the launcher does

  • Creates a native Tauri tray icon and launcher window.
  • Starts the existing CI-Applet monitor binary on demand.
  • Opens the existing egui settings editor without duplicating config logic.
  • Keeps the background capture and analysis pipeline in the root Rust crate.

Tray actions

  • Show Launcher re-opens this window.
  • Launch Monitor starts the background capture binary once.
  • Open Settings launches the shared --settings-ui flow.
  • Quit Launcher exits the Tauri shell.

Build targets

  • Windows, macOS, and Linux desktop launcher builds use Tauri v2.
  • The monitor binary remains the root Rust package.
  • Set CI_APPLET_MONITOR_BIN to override where the launcher looks for the root binary.

Architecture refresh

This keeps the screenshot worker, MinIO uploader, Postgres recorder, and vision analysis code untouched while introducing a packaging-friendly Tauri desktop shell. The tray UX is now split into a launcher layer and the existing capture engine so the monitor can continue to evolve independently.
